display_name: 源连续特征响应保持恢复器，从零单阶段 30 轮
description: 原 dense 响应恢复器增加源端 F0 连续特征差分响应损失，训练部署仍使用相同后验。

data.representation: Original R07 L_s6300/U_s56700 clean/received plus simulator Action/noise; original global/other-RX source moments. One fixed1% source-RMS perturbation per row/epoch.
data.actual_training_labels: Zero TX labels. Original physical Action/noise source supervision, paired IQ/STFT, continuous frozen F0, source IQ response and source continuous feature response.
data.augmentation: Original fixed1%-RMS source IQ perturbation in one of four directions; source Action maps delta into received with the same realized noise.

permissions.query_use: Source RX selects training prior/mode factor only. Deployed G consumes current IQ and its fixed source buffers. No V/OE/target fit or TX truth.
permissions.claim_scope: No target training, source TX labels, V/OE fitting, F0 logits/CE, new identity head, or prior G weights. Deployed G consumes only received IQ and fixed source buffers.

checkpoint.initialization: All 1471463 G parameters from scratch with original physical and prior seeds; no control G weights or optimizer state loaded.
sources: FROZEN_F0 original Tri-SIG-TIME SSL and legal original source moments.

metric_names: Original ground Tri-SIG-TIME SSL frozen default head Main168000: raw clean145385; each practical>=140345 and both raw clean populations 111019/34366 preserved.
Every TX/RX/day group and paired raw/DURA repairs/damage; same-input ResponseDense comparison only after both complete matrices are fixed.
All30 source logs and source permutations; separate IQ and feature response error, posterior residual, finite state, wall time and peak memory.
1,471,463 G parameters, two dense posterior calls and four F0 feature passes per source row during training; one dense posterior and no F0 in deployed G.
dimensions: original Main two populations and seven views

rows.purpose: Test whether preserving original F0 continuous feature differences of source perturbations improves task-relevant restoration beyond IQ response alone.
rows.seed_notes: Physical2026092701/confidence2026092702, original source order2026110102 and R07 draws. Existing source subset2026110707. No new stochastic prior fit.

notes: Fixed source-only 224-row study found F0 response errors in synthetic directions, including high and broadly distributed phase-slope errors. Synthetic directions do not establish actual TX hardware derivatives or an information limit.

Feature response equals F0(G(y+Aδ))-F0(G(y)) minus [F0(x+δ)-F0(x)], variance-normalized; denominator uses reference response energy plus 1e-4 source feature energy and minimum 1e-12. The added term has weight .01.

Same original ResponseDense E0, priors, optimizer, schedule, data and IQ response; no control weights loaded. The extra two differentiable F0 passes and one detached clean-perturbed F0 pass per source row are explicitly counted.

Eleven focused local tests PASS, including actual objective gradients in a synthetic model and technical recovery regression. One independent P0/P1 review PASS. Real F0/source2/E0/feature-response-gradient smoke is the first remote step and is not yet passed.
Both Main populations and all seven views are predicted before independent truth-last. No target result is used to adjust this or another candidate. Default DURA unchanged.
